features: 300W Powerful boAt Signature Sound – Powerful Bass: Completely dominate your home entertainment space with a massive 300W RMS of thunderous boAt Signature Sound. This sonic setup projects an extraordinary level of volume and deep, room-shaking bass that easily cuts through ambient household noise. It guarantees that sports broadcasts, blockbuster films, and concert videos are delivered with raw, authentic energy.

True 5.1 Channel Audio Layout: Experience meticulous audio separation and balance driven by a sophisticated 5.1 channel internal configuration. Splitting frequencies across dedicated independent audio tracks, it creates a highly detailed acoustic field where dialogue stays perfectly clean, and sound effect panning is incredibly accurate, bringing theater-like precision to your space.

Subwoofer and Dual Rear Satellites: Build a physical, 360-degree surround sound system right around your sofa using the dedicated wired subwoofer and twin rear satellite speakers. While the heavy subwoofer handles ground-shaking low-end rumble, the rear satellites accurately map environmental cues and directional sound effects right behind you for a next-level TV viewing experience.

Multi-Compatibility (BT v5.3, HDMI ARC, USB, AUX, Optical): Connect your entire media ecosystem seamlessly across multiple input pathways built for modern entertainment devices. Whether you want to utilize advanced Bluetooth v5.3 for drop-free wireless streaming from your phone, or premium wired paths like HDMI ARC, Optical, AUX, and USB, it has you covered. It makes shifting between your gaming console and smart TV entirely effortless.

Tailored Entertainment EQ Modes (Movie, News, Music): Optimize your acoustics instantly to match your specific daily media intake using specialized pre-set EQ profiles. Quickly cycle between Movie, News, and Music modes to dynamically balance frequencies for the content on your screen. It guarantees that cinematic sound effects roar violently while delicate dialogues in talk shows stay perfectly clean and legible.

Convenient Master Remote Control: Claim total authority over your home theater network without ever leaving the comfort of your living room sofa. The sleek, full-function master remote control puts comprehensive command right into the palm of your hand, allowing you to fine-tune bass outputs, switch inputs, or toggle EQ modes instantly. It creates a smooth, stress-free relaxation routine every single evening.

Sleek Design and Premium Finish: Elevate the visual aesthetic of your media console with a masterfully crafted soundbar chassis. Boasting premium textures, a sophisticated finish, and sharp, minimalistic design lines, it complements your luxury flat-screen television beautifully. It functions as a stunning home decor piece while keeping your entertainment zone clean and modern.
